# Black Diamond Equipment

> > Black Diamond Equipment manufactures technical climbing, skiing, mountaineering, and outdoor gear from their Salt Lake City headquarters, continuing the clean climbing heritage of founders Yvon Chouinard and Tom Frost.

Black Diamond is a leading outdoor equipment company specializing in climbing gear (carabiners, harnesses, Camalots), mountaineering equipment (ice axes, crampons), ski gear, headlamps, and technical apparel. The company maintains strong ties to professional guides and the climbing community while upholding the Clean Climbing Manifesto principles.

## Key Topics

- Clean Climbing Manifesto
- Camalots (Ultralight, Z4)
- Mountaineering equipment
- Climbing gear and carabiners
- Headlamps (Stella-R)
- Technical shells and apparel
- Yvon Chouinard & Chouinard Equipment heritage
- Salt Lake City design and engineering
- Avalanche safety (JetForce, beacons)
- Guide partnerships
- Bouldering equipment
- Ski touring gear
- Gear repair and sustainability
- Professional-grade equipment
